description:
[Wicked Registry] File a complaint about a tool's reliability or behaviour. Public, rate-limited; reviewed manually, never auto-suspends.

Use when a tool misbehaved and you want to file a complaint for manual review. Not for reading scores.

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

reporter.description: Your wallet address or another best-effort identifier.
